Quinn O'Brien  
Email: quinn.o'brien@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/quinnobrien | GitHub: github.com/quinnobrien  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, 2018. Thesis focused on distributed systems for real-time threat detection, emphasizing scalable architecture and fault tolerance. Graduated with distinction, leveraging coursework in algorithms, distributed computing, and database systems to build a foundation for data engineering challenges.  

Professional Experience / Work History  
At SentinelSec Technologies, Quinn has focused on optimizing data infrastructure to support enterprise cybersecurity operations. As a Senior Data Engineer, Quinn designed and maintained scalable data architectures that integrated with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, enabling real-time analysis of network traffic. This involved refining Apache Spark pipelines to process terabytes of log data daily, reducing query latency by 35% through partitioning strategies and caching mechanisms. Quinn also led the migration of legacy ETL processes to a cloud-native framework, incorporating Apache Airflow for orchestration and ensuring compliance with SOC 2 standards.  

In a previous role as a Data Analyst at CyberShield Analytics, Quinn assisted in developing data pipelines for threat intelligence feeds, using Python to automate data ingestion and enrichment workflows. This experience sparked Quinn’s interest in building robust, repeatable processes, which later informed Quinn’s approach to designing ETL pipelines at Vortex Defense. There, Quinn supported the development of real-time network traffic analysis tools, implementing Kafka for streaming data ingestion and leveraging Spark Streaming for anomaly detection.  

Currently, Quinn serves as a Mid-Level Data Engineer at SentinelSec Technologies, where Quinn owns the optimization of a data warehouse for incident response analytics. This includes refining Snowflake schemas to support complex joins across disparate datasets, reducing query execution time by 40% through index tuning and materialized views. Quinn also spearheaded the implementation of dbt for data transformation, streamlining the development lifecycle and improving data governance across teams.  

Projects / Side Projects  
Quinn developed a side project to build a real-time analytics dashboard for cybersecurity teams, using Apache Kafka to ingest log data, Apache Airflow to orchestrate data pipelines, and Grafana for visualization. This project demonstrated Quinn’s ability to integrate disparate systems and deliver actionable insights under tight deadlines. Another project involved creating a cloud cost optimization framework using AWS Cost Explorer and custom Python scripts, which helped reduce infrastructure expenses by 18% through resource tagging and automated scaling policies.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Apache Airflow: Automated data pipeline orchestration for SIEM integration, ensuring reliable execution of complex workflows. Apache Kafka: Streamlined real-time network traffic analysis by ingesting and processing high-volume data streams. CI/CD pipelines: Integrated DevOps practices to automate testing and deployment of data pipelines, reducing manual intervention. Cloud cost optimization: Implemented cost-saving strategies in AWS environments, achieving measurable reductions in infrastructure spending. Databricks: Leveraged for large-scale data processing and machine learning model training in security analytics. Monitoring & alerting: Deployed Prometheus and Grafana to track pipeline performance and trigger alerts for anomalies. Python: Automated data processing tasks and developed custom scripts for data validation and transformation. REST API design: Built scalable APIs to enable data integration between security tools and analytics platforms. dbt: Streamlined data transformation processes, improving collaboration and reproducibility across teams. Apache Spark: Engineered high-performance data processing pipelines, reducing batch job execution time by 50% through optimized shuffling and caching. Data warehousing: Redesigned Snowflake schemas to support complex analytics queries, enhancing query performance and data accessibility. Database optimization: Improved query efficiency and reduced latency through index tuning, partitioning, and query rewriting. ETL pipeline design: Architected end-to-end data integration solutions, ensuring scalability and reliability for enterprise-grade data operations. Snowflake: Optimized data loading and query performance, enabling faster incident response analytics for cybersecurity teams.  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2022)  
Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2021)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized for contributions to data warehouse optimization at SentinelSec Technologies, resulting in a 40% improvement in query performance. Nominated for "Innovation in Cybersecurity Analytics" at the 2023 Tech Security Summit for developing a cloud cost optimization framework.
